notes.title: 40% Off Weeklong Promotion
notes.notes:
European Speedrunner Assembly's winter event, [url=https://esamarathon.com/ettevent/esa-winter-2024/]ESA Winter 2024[/url] is in full swing over in Sweden and among the games showcased during this charity speedrunner event was desunoya's Tobari and the Night of the Curious Moon. You can check out the stream [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2067545618]here[/url].

For viewers that might've caught the stream and are curious about the game, we're doing a weeklong promotion this week from February 19 to 26 where the game and the OST will be 40% off!

Whether you enjoy speedrunning or are looking for a whimsical yet deceptively challenging indie game, Tobari will challenge all comers.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/368140/Tobari_and_the_Night_of_the_Curious_Moon/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1243570/Tobari_and_the_Night_of_the_Curious_Moon_Soundtrack/

Curious about desunoya's other titles? Check out what's available on the official [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/desunoya]desunoya Steam Developer page[/url]!
